prompt: Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT. Create ONE alternate studio catalog photograph of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: plain head-shaped woven display form without facial markings on a smooth bamboo neck and weighted base; front smooth oval face, right side head profile, rear seam with bound edges. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. All interiors empty. Preserve natural product pose, including open lid state. CAMERA: exact REAR: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, matching elevation. Rear nearest camera; front features on far side and appropriately occluded. Preserve exact shape, frame, color, weave, number and locations of compartments, handles, legs, ribs, hinges and secondary materials. Reveal previously hidden surfaces consistently. Do not redesign, mirror or repeat front camera. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
